customManagers.description: Container images pinned by digest where no built-in manager reads them: the release workflow's build container expression and the Bazel execution platforms.
The sccache release every sccache-action step installs (the action would otherwise take the newest at run time).

packageRules.description: Keep routine dependency updates in one validation train

A digest update of a pinned action (its tag now names another commit) waits for approval on the dependency dashboard: minimumReleaseAge holds back new versions only, and a moved tag keeps its original date.
What the customManagers above pin (container digests, the sccache release) builds CI and the release: proposed a week after its release, in a group of its own, and never automerged.

GitHub Actions run with the workflow token, OIDC and release secrets: pinned to commit SHAs (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests, checked by scripts/ci-action-pins.mjs), new versions proposed a week after their release, in a group of their own, and never automerged. Keep this rule last.
